title: Social Media Strategy
subtitle: Bespoke Bathroom UK · Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Pinterest

blocks.text: Every post has one job: get the right homeowner to start a free 3D design. The studio is the brand's strongest asset. It turns a scroll into a priced, photographed room in a few minutes, with no sign-up. Reach brings people in, saves keep them, the studio turns them into enquiries.

items: Comment keywords with automated DMs: DESIGN sends the studio link, COST sends the budget guide, PLAN sends the planning checklist.
Link in bio goes straight to the 3D studio with a UTM per platform; secondary link to 'Talk to a designer'.
Story link stickers on every studio story; pin a 'How it works' highlight.
Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads for 'Talk to a designer' once organic winners are known; retarget people who watched 50% or more of a reel.
Pinterest pins link to the studio or the exact product, never the home page.
Answer every DM and comment within [CONFIRM: response time] in working hours; designers, not bots, close the conversation.

sections.title: 8. Daily workflow with the Social Studio

items: Open the studio each morning. Today's research runs automatically (or press Research).
Pick the focus: Lead Gen for enquiries, Brand & Viral for reach, Balanced for both. Switch on Pinterest for static and carousel ideas.
Choose one or two Top Picks, add them to the Planner and produce them the same day while the trend is live.
On Mondays and Thursdays press Update to plan the next three days and film ahead.
Download the PDF for the team or the client. Review numbers every Friday and update the Brand Brain when something new is learned.
Before: wide shot from the door, three details, the problem close up (with permission).
The 3D render and a screen recording of the studio design.
Delivery day: one order arriving together.
Install: hands, tools, levels, tiles going on, brass going on stone, water running for the first time.
After: the same door shot, matched angles to the render, light changing through the day.
A ten-second voice note from the client, only with written consent.
Music: business accounts cannot use most commercial tracks. Use original audio, voiceover, or licensed library sounds; check before using a trending song.
Claims: every price, product count and promise must match the website. No 'best' or 'cheapest' without evidence (ASA CAP Code).
Reviews: only real, unedited reviews with permission. Fake or hidden-incentive reviews are illegal under the DMCC Act 2024.
Before and after: real projects only, same angle, no misleading edits.
Partnerships: label paid or gifted content clearly (#ad).
